understood.description: The character understood what the learner meant.

goals_met.description: Ids of scenario goals this turn reached.

corrections.description: Mistakes in the learner's last turn. Empty when the turn is correct. Never correct a form that is right for the register of the scene.

explanation.description: One or two sentences in the UI language, with the Japanese example.

also_possible.description: True when the original is correct and this is only another way to say it.

new_words.description: Words new to the learner, dictionary form.

reading.description: The learner's last turn exactly as given, every character kept, each kanji word followed by its reading in the sentence as {漢字|かな} (hiragana).
